ASCII Markdown characters are escaped when escapeAscii is true

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<p>Text with # hash and [brackets] and * star</p>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(escape_ascii: true))
puts result.content.inspect
```
